name: USB Hub Support
author: NachoCasta
summary: Hub USB sources with port-based numbers and rekordbox names/colors.
description: Connect up to eight USB sticks through a hub. USB numbers follow hub ports; native sources appear first, followed by hub sources in numeric order. Shows rekordbox device names and colors, with analyzed waveforms. Press USB STOP to select one stick or hold to eject the hub; wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Experimental Ethernet PRO DJ LINK sharing; actual CDJs and Wi-Fi sharing remain unvalidated. Exact firmware 2.00 ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel 4.4.194; core >=1.2.3.
